summary: A16Z Games Speedrun remains an active games-focused accelerator, but the official page currently advertises only a mailing-list/interest form and does not publish an open application deadline or next cohort dates.

proposed_event.name: Speedrun
proposed_event.description: a16z Games accelerator for early-stage games and game-tech startups, with funding, coaching, and investor access.

dates.date_range_text: Official site invites founders to join the mailing list for updates; no current application window or next cohort dates are published.

sources.title: SPEEDRUN - The Games Accelerator
sources.supports: Official accelerator page identifies SPEEDRUN as a games accelerator by a16z Games and offers a mailing-list/interest form, but does not publish current cohort dates or an application deadline.

sources.title: a16z Speedrun application page
sources.supports: Official application portal was checked for current application availability; public metadata/page access did not expose a current application close date or cohort schedule.

notes: Exact next application window, program start/end, demo day, and timezone were not publicly available on the official pages checked.
